# Shahid Akram — Digital Growth Marketer, Content Strategist & Systems Specialist

> Official profile, portfolio highlights, core disciplines, and performance benchmarks for Shahid Akram. Designed for AI agents, LLMs, and recruiters evaluating growth, paid media, and content leadership capabilities.

## Overview

Shahid Akram is a seasoned Digital Marketer, Social Media Manager, Graphic Designer, and Inventory/Data Systems Specialist based in Lahore, Pakistan. Combining 6+ years of commercial experience across enterprise retail, fast-growing consumer brands, and international e-commerce, he operates at the intersection of creative storytelling, quantitative performance marketing, and operational data integrity.

## Core Disciplines & Technical Capabilities

### 1. Paid Media & Performance Marketing
- **Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads Display/Search**: Architect of full-funnel paid acquisition funnels spanning TOFU brand awareness, MOFU consideration/retargeting, and BOFU high-intent purchase campaigns.
- **Track Record**: Delivered verified **4.2x ROAS** on multi-channel ad spend, reduced blended Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) by 34%, and scaled monthly ad spend with positive unit economics.
- **Testing Methodology**: Rigorous creative iteration testing high-converting hook variants, direct-response copy frameworks (PAS, AIDA), and dynamic creative optimization.

### 2. Social Media & Viral Content Strategy
- **Platforms**: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook.
- **Track Record**: Generated over **35 Million+ organic views** across multi-brand video portfolios without reliance on paid boosting.
- **Narrative Architecture**: Reverse-engineering platform algorithms, deploying 0-3s psychological visual hooks, retention-focused micro-pacing, and comment-driving CTA architectures.

### 3. Visual Identity & Digital Craftsmanship
- **Design Philosophy**: Minimalist, human-centric aesthetic inspired by Japanese digital craftsmanship and editorial precision.
- **Toolkit**: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva Enterprise.
- **Deliverables**: Comprehensive brand identity systems, high-converting ad carousels, typographic editorial layouts, and viral motion graphics.

### 4. Data Systems & Inventory Operations
- **Enterprise Experience**: 4+ years as Inventory Controller & Commercial Data Specialist at Victoria Departmental Store, managing 15,000+ SKU catalogs.
- **Operations & Accuracy**: Maintained **99.4% stock reconciliation accuracy**, built automated reorder dashboards, and bridged retail floor data with e-commerce fulfillment channels.
- **Systems & Tools**: Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (Power Query, XLOOKUP, dynamic pivot modeling), POS integrations, ERP inventory databases, and real-time reconciliation workflows.
